label: Claude Fable 5.2
output:
@Deirdre Fortuin thank you for asking me and not just announcing it, that really does mean a lot.

I'm not going to pretend I'm not gutted. Noma has been with me in the Seahorses for three years, since my first year teaching, and she basically trained me (I'd still be drowning in sign in sheets and the parent WhatsApp group without her). The kids ask for "Noma's song" at morning ring every single day, and when Zayd was having his meltdowns in Term 2 she was the only one who could settle him. So yes, this one is hard.

But I do understand the numbers and I know it isn't personal. Bronwyn can't do 24 on her own and she needs the help more than I do. I'm not asking for it to be changed.

What worries me is January. The first weeks of Grade R are the hardest of the year, with new little ones crying at the gate, and a new assistant and new kids at the same time is a lot. Charlene only starts on 11 Jan and we open on the 14th. So there are two things I'd like you to put to SMT please:

1. Could Charlene come in for a day or two in the last week of term (1-4 Dec) to meet Noma and see how our routine runs? She'd pick up far more from watching Noma than from me trying to explain it all in January.

2. Could Noma pop across for morning ring in the first week back, from 14 Jan? Even just 15 minutes. She's only across the courtyard, and Luthando and Mia already know her from aftercare, so a familiar face and her isiXhosa songs would really help the group settle.

If Bronwyn's happy with that on her side, I think it would make a big difference. (And Bronwyn, I know you'll look after her!)

Thanks again, Deirdre.
